reviews.title: Excited to do this.
reviews.text: 9/29/26 this is my first day doing this and so far it’s wonderful.  I’m so excited to see and experience how my life is finally going to change for the better.   My life has been a blessing, but I’ve wasted the majority of it by being lazy and giving up on so many things.   I thank God for not giving up on me and using Hal’s book and this app to open my eyes and mind to what He has had planned for my life and for me to do.   I’m so excited to fulfill His purpose.

reviews.title: Overwhelm
reviews.text: I love the book. And I bought the journal. And I joined the Facebook group. And I intended to buy a years worth of the app.But it was just too much. Maybe some people prefer having a voice do all the thinking for them but for me I really need the silence in the morning.

reviews.title: Miracle Morning
reviews.text: I love this app. It reminds me every morning to do this.  Love  the ideas they have. Hal Elrod is a positive person and I love his listening to his inspiring podcasts!

reviews.title: Book and App
reviews.text: This book I had in my audible library for a while and just stumbled upon and finally started reading it, it’s been a great help. Thank you to ME and to Hal

reviews.title: Good app but buggy
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for about 3 months now. Most days it isn’t bad but some days it is extremely laggy and checking off my daily items doesn’t always work. Then this morning (April 8, 2026) I can’t open the app at all on my iPhone Pro Max 17 nor on my iPad. It opens then immediately crashes on both devices. Extremely frustrating and not a good way to start the day.

reviews.title: Offline Capabilities Please!!
reviews.text: Love the app, huge fan of Miracle Morning. The ability to download tracks offline would be a game changer! There are many times where I'm traveling without access to internet, or I've shut off my internet to improve my sleep quality, but I still want to listen to a soundtrack. I really loved the Calm app because I was able to download soundtracks and use them offline. Hope you can add this feature in!!

reviews.title: What a great app
reviews.text: I am so happy with this app.

reviews.title: Buggy, frequent crashes
reviews.text: Day one it seemed like it was working and I was enjoying it so day two I got up extra early and no dice, app keeps saying something went wrong so I deleted it and downloaded again and still won’t load anymore. Needless to say I cancelled my subscription. Bummer because I thought this might really help me after reading the book.

reviews.title: All in one

reviews.title: Book ideas
reviews.text: I’m glad I found the book in the app believe it or not thank Jesse from Savannah Bananas from his publicity and interviews book ideas for first responders and healthcare workers because we work 12 hour shifts sometimes we work 24 hours and then 72 hours off some work overnight and by the time they get off in the morning, they either go home to all of the things or to sleep. Second book idea for singles who are single parents even if it’s being a dog mom.  🧡

reviews.title: Fantastic app
reviews.text: I first did Miracle Morning when the book originally came out. Since meeting Hal at a conference last week I have started again and downloaded the app as well. I love this app!  It’s simple yet has everything you need to do the miracle morning.

reviews.title: Just what I wanted
reviews.text: App is easy to use and does not take much time.

reviews.title: Optimistic
reviews.text: This is day two of my miracle morning, and I will say that I was very optimistic doing this considering I read the book during my hospital to stay. it was definitely essential to my release. And gave me great coping skills to deal with my anxiety. Thanks again for sharing your story. I was already in the process of sharing mines and finished my first book ever while in the hospital. Thanks again, My Pal Hal❤️ I don’t usually write reviews. This time was a must.

reviews.title: Over delivery of features!
reviews.text: The app has so much detail about improvement and the 6 SAVERS, that make it perfect for staying on track. I haven’t explored it fully but I think some AI tools would be a nice addition for custom affirmations perhaps. Inder Activites, things like  “visualization prompts” and affirmations ask is to swipe down, and it would be nice to get a shortcut to the bottom or any which one you wanted to save time. But I understand they are all good to read, so it’s just the impatience in me because I haven’t meditate enough😆. Love the app. Excited to make it a daily ritual.

reviews.title: I regret not using this app sooner!
reviews.text: I have been looking for exactly what this app delivers. It is simple, efficient, and dialed in. I highly recommend it to anyone who is trying to take a lovers leap in life. This is literally a gift to yourself.

reviews.title: Exceeds my expectations
reviews.text: I finally stepped in fully. On day 3 and already my days have been brighter. On day one, I felt a weight lifted and day two, I carried confidence. I watched the movie last night and so blessed that it’s made to be customized to your own world view because it’s not a religious practice, it’s just a tool for creating your best routine. My faith lenses shapes what my miracle morning looks like and I am finally setting up my day rather than it setting me up.

reviews.title: App is clunky

If my morning routine is such an obstacle, I don’t need a app that only partially works to give me more obstacles

reviews.title: Made my morning routine stick!
reviews.text: I am a woman diagnosed in high school then later in life again.  Needless to say, it’s challenging for me to stick to routines despite the fact that they are best thing for me. I’ve tried all different approaches to my morning routine from extensive to elementary. This app really provides the structure to stay in one app to do the morning routine. It’s given me hope!

reviews.title: Miracle morning is a miracle. It was shared from a friend
reviews.text: It’s the right time right now for me to make some changes in my life and to become the version I always want or talk about or pray for. With the Lord’s help I am giving it my best and I am stronger for journaling. My mind anyway. My negative ruminating thoughts have already gotten so much better this first week and I just found out about this. Thank you to Hal and my friends who believe in and share the miracle morning method 🙌🏼 here’s to a wonderful life

reviews.title: Recommitting myself
reviews.text: I’ve done the Miracle Morning in the past & had my best year ever. I’ve drifted since & now I’m recommitting myself to the Miracle Morning process and this app makes it simple, fun to see your progress, and I love the choices the app gives. All successful people start their day with a morning routine. If you are a successful person, then you’re probably already doing some kind of morning routine. If you desire to be more successful than I believe this is an excellent step. In my opinion, this is the best morning routine. It’s like a morning routine on steroids.

reviews.title: Don’t bother unless you are willing to pay for an annual subscription.
reviews.text: Not worth it unless you’re willing to upgrade with an annual subscription. Pretty much everything is locked unless you pay more. You can get most of the locked items free elsewhere, such as affirmations, meditations, etc.

reviews.title: The best beginner-friendly guide
reviews.text: The app offers a seven day free trial session with quick 4 to 5 minute sessions to jumpstart your S.A.V.E.R.S. routine. Then there are other various sessions or challenges( 3, 7 or 30 days) that you can choose from to help build your habits. The prompts and templates are simple and straightforward especially if you’re just starting out with your personal development journey. I read the book first and later decided to use this app. It’s my accountability partner because it gives you a daily reminder or notification besides my phone alarm. It’s working well for me so I paid for a year subscription. Now I’m hooked!
